decided the wheels made the land fortress look a little to much like a camper van, so had a first try at manipulating some existing work to fit. used this classic little necromunda loader tracks, a fantastic little kit i love to use. after some trile and errore i have gotten something that works, all be it a little rough around the edges.

i printed these with 20% infill and 0.12 layer hight, wihtout suports.

enjoy :)

After finding the awesome Lifter made by Dxsus, I printed it out as I wanted to use it as an alternate sentinel model for my Squats force I am working on.

I then realised it needed a Flamer on it to act as a proper vehicle.

A bit of tinkering later, and I have a cool looking industrial lifter with a flamer turret.

You will need to use Dxsus original lifter to get all the parts that aren't included here.

This is ONLY the Engine/Cowling/Turret back section of the lifter.
